title: How to build an AI model to recognize objects
reading: The slide frames object recognition as a pipeline: an input picture is passed to an image classifier, which outputs a label such as 'dog' or 'cat'. The analogy given is human perception — see a picture, tell the object class. The classifier itself is characterized as a sequence of 'learnable' computation, hinting that its internal parameters are fit from data rather than hand-designed.

visuals.description: Implied pipeline flow from an input image, through a box labelled 'Image Classifier', to an output label (e.g., dog or cat), with an annotation that the classifier is a sequence of learnable computation.
visuals.assertion: An image classifier maps raw image input to a class label via composed learnable operations.
